jobs.title: Customer Value Engineer
jobs.description:
comstruct turns the paper chaos of construction into structured data. We extract material data from delivery notes and invoices at item level and automate what construction companies still do by hand: documentation, invoice entry, reconciliation. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us empower the industry with smarter and more efficient solutions.

 

About the role 🦺

As our Customer Value Engineer you own our most valuable accounts once the rollout is done and make sure every customer gets maximum value out of our product.

Most of your time you're with customers: driving adoption across sites and teams, building ROI models and running strategic QBRs that prove monetary value to decision makers. You build lasting relationships from site managers to C-level, spot expansion opportunities into new business units and geographies and qualify them before Sales gets involved. Working closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you bring customer feedback from the field directly into our product development.

You love owning accounts end-to-end and turning customer success into revenue? Then this role is for you!

 

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Own our most valuable accounts: Act as the main point of contact and trusted partner for our customers after rollout. You build relationships that turn one-off projects into long-term valuable and strategic partnerships.

  • Drive adoption on site: Onboard teams across construction sites and business units and make sure comstruct gets used as their everyday working tool.

  • Prove Value & ROI: Move the conversation from "simple features" to "concrete valuable outcomes." You build ROI models and lead strategic QBRs that prove the monetary value of our product to decision makers.

  • Expand your accounts: You view your accounts as a business that needs to grow. You identify expansion opportunities, build value cases and draft and negotiate contracts together with our AEs.

  • Shape the product from the field: You know best with what our customers struggle on site and you make sure our FDE and product team hears it. That feedback shapes what we build next.

     

What we're looking for ✨

  • You bring 1-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account or Project Management, Consulting, managing complex accounts with multi-layered hierarchies. You have structured onboarding plans across multiple stakeholders and driven alignment and adoption across multiple branches.

  • You are deeply commercially minded. Discussing pricing and defending value comes naturally to you and you instinctively spot where an account can grow.

  • You don't need to code, but you can read and map an ERP integration, assess what's feasible and push back in a room full of engineers.

  • You are curious to dig deep into our product. You want to understand how things work under the hood and you naturally connect what customers need with what the product can do.

  • You are a natural communicator. People enjoy working with you, whether that's a site manager in a container office or a CFO in a boardroom.

  • You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel

  • You speak German on a native level and are fluent in English.

Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

 

Why join comstruct? 🛠️

Construction is one of the largest and least digitized industries in the world. We're building its digital future. Founded in March 2022, we've raised a €12.5M seed round from 20VC, Google Ventures and top European investors and nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors already run on comstruct. That's the foundation. The category-defining company gets built now - together with you!

 

What we offer

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CEO Henric Meinhardt, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca and Italy.

  • Coordinate structural analyses and mechanical verification activities, with focus on test strategy and execution, from test definition and prediction to result interpretation and model correlation, ensuring results are coherent, traceable, and aligned with programme objectives.

  • Ensure verification evidence generated through testing and analysis is robust, review-ready, and suitable for qualification and certification activities towards space agencies.

  • Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Strong background in structure design, structural analysis, justification, qualification, and verification.

OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades – together, with modern software and smart AI solutions.
We don’t just develop software – we’re on a mission to give tradespeople and contractors more room to focus on what matters. We do this by providing a practical SaaS solution that works the way they do: fast, efficient, and without unnecessary administrative overhead. Backed by Tier 1 investors from Europe and the US such as Headline and Creandum, and with more than 30,000 craftspeople as our customer base, we are scaling across Europe to turn individual, scattered businesses into connected and successful communities.
We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people wearing safety boots in mind, not suits. We’re excited to shape the future together as a team, staying grounded in our mission to empower the builders and makers of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As (Senior) People Operations & Excellence Manager, you build and continuously improve the operational foundations that enable our People Operations & Partnering function to scale. You design efficient processes, strengthen our systems, automate repetitive work, and create the standards that allow managers and employees to navigate People Operations matters with ease.

As plancraft continues to grow with 160+ employees across Germany and Europe, this role is key to building a scalable, data-driven, and future-ready People Operations function. You combine reliable operational execution with a continuous improvement mindset—using day-to-day operational insights to simplify workflows, improve data quality, expand self-service, and drive practical automation across the employee lifecycle.

Next to the operational day-to-day business, a key part of your role is translating operational insights into better processes. You design standardized workflows, build SOPs and knowledge resources, improve data quality and reporting, and identify practical opportunities to leverage automation and AI across our People Operations landscape. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you help establish an integrated operating model that combines operational reliability with continuous improvement.

You will work particularly closely with:

  • our Lead People Operations & Partnering, who will be your direct manager and strategic counterpart for continuously evolving our People Operations & Partnering model across Germany and international locations.

  • our broader People & Organization team, to align seamless end-to-end people processes.

  • technical stakeholders, to bring more complex processes and automations to life.

  • employees across the organization, you are supporting in their employee lifecycle.

This is a role with broad cross-functional exposure, significant ownership, and the opportunity to shape how People Operations scales at plancraft. If you enjoy combining operational excellence with systems thinking, process design, automation, and continuous improvement, you'll have the opportunity to leave a lasting impact on one of the company's core enabling functions.


Your Responsibilities

End-to-End People Operations

  • Own the day-to-day delivery of core People Operations processes, including HRIS administration (Personio), contract amendments, payroll inputs, employee data management, and recurring documentation requests.

  • Ensure reliable, compliant, and high-quality execution across the entire employee lifecycle

  • Support the operational implementation of international employment setups, entity transitions, and evolving People Operations requirements as we continue to grow across Europe.

Operational Excellence, Automation & Insights

  • Own the continuous improvement of People Operations processes by identifying repetitive friction, manual effort, unclear handovers and opportunities to simplify or standardize how work gets done.

  • Design better end-to-end workflows and implement practical improvements through existing tools, low-code or no-code solutions, AI-enabled workflows and scalable self-service formats.

  • Lead automation initiatives from problem identification and process design through implementation and adoption, partnering with internal technical experts where deeper integrations or more complex builds are required.

  • Build ways to monitor meaningful operational metrics, create dashboards and reporting and translate data and operational patterns into concrete recommendations, improvement priorities and accessible insights for relevant stakeholders.

  • Continuously develop and maintain the manager enablement and self-service ecosystem, including practical guides, playbooks, templates, knowledge resources and learning formats.

 

YOUR PROFILE

Must-Have Skills

  • 2–3 years of experience in People Operations, or a comparable operational People role.

  • Proven experience in managing core employee lifecycle processes, including HR administration, contract management, payroll inputs, and HRIS maintenance.

  • Strong process thinking with a passion for improving workflows rather than simply executing them with high affinity for HR systems, structured documentation, and data quality.

  • Experience managing operational employee and manager requests with accuracy, reliability, and a strong service mindset.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, prioritize improvements, and translate insights into scalable solutions.

  • Great curiosity and ideally first experiences in applying automation and AI to improve operational efficiency.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German & English (C1/C2 level); additional European languages are a plus.

  • Experience in a scale-up or high-growth environment .

  • Located within Germany with willingness to come to our Hamburg HQs minimum once per quarter, ideally every few weeks.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Working in an HR function in a company with international employment setups.

  • Familiarity with Personio, Leapsome, Notion, Slack Workflows, or similar HR technology.

  • Exposure to no-code automation, AI-assisted workflows, or reporting and dashboard tools.

  • Additional European language skills.



Who this Role is for
You're someone who enjoys bringing structure to complexity. Rather than accepting inefficient processes, you naturally look for better ways of working and get energy from making systems simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

You enjoy balancing hands-on operational work with continuous improvement. Solving recurring challenges through better processes, automation, AI, and self-service feels just as rewarding as delivering an excellent employee experience in the day-to-day.

You are someone who:

  • enjoys building scalable processes instead of repeatedly solving the same problem

  • combines operational excellence with a pragmatic, hands-on mindset

  • naturally spots inefficiencies and turns them into practical improvements

  • is curious about leveraging AI and automation to simplify repetitive work

  • enjoys creating clarity through documentation, playbooks, and structured ways of working

  • uses data and operational insights to prioritize improvements and measure impact

  • takes ownership while collaborating closely with colleagues across the business

  • values accuracy, reliability, and compliance without losing sight of the employee experience

  • enjoys building solutions that make life easier for managers, employees, and the People team alike

If you're excited by the idea of building the operational backbone that enables our People function to scale, we'd love to meet you.

 

WHY PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

A definitive shift is currently happening. Corporates across the globe are no longer just reporting on sustainability; they are actively investing in it as a core financial and strategic asset.

We are looking for a Tech Lead to join our engineering team. Moving beyond traditional software delivery, you will translate product vision into reliable technology, lead critical architectural decisions, and leave a lasting mark on our platform from day one.

  • Architect and scale a seamless B2B procurement platform, delivering an intuitive, enterprise-grade user interface designed for daily engagement and complex workflows.

  • Drive end-to-end technical strategy, design, and architecture, translating ambitious product requirements into performant, scalable features and microservices.

  • Lead by example with hands-on technical execution, authoring high-quality, maintainable code across our TypeScript, Node.js, and Next.js stack.

  • Cultivate engineering excellence across the team, providing high-impact mentorship, technical guidance, and rigorous code reviews to continuously elevate development standards.

  • Safeguard platform integrity, establishing robust security, reliability, and performance standards across our applications and core cloud infrastructure.

  • Partner closely with product, design, and cross-functional teams, evaluating trade-offs and technical permutations to engineer optimal, user-centric solutions.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of technical leadership (2+ years) guiding teams through complex, full-lifecycle product deliveries.

  • Deep technical proficiency in TypeScript and the Node.js ecosystem, alongside extensive hands-on experience building modern, data-dense interfaces with React or Next.js.

  • Strong architectural expertise in RESTful API design, backend systems architecture, and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL experience preferred).

  • Demonstrated commitment to engineering rigour, with a deep understanding of software design patterns, enterprise web security standards, and modern development workflows (Git, feature branching).

  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure and continuous deployment, including hands-on experience building and maintaining services on platforms like AWS.

  • Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical decisions, bridge alignment across product teams, and mentor engineers.

  • Basic familiarity with Python is a plus, or a strong technical curiosity to expand into auxiliary parts of our data processing stack.


The hiring process

  • An intro call with the People Team

  • A Technical Interview with our SVP of Tech, Felipe

  • A Case Study with 2 Engineers from the team

What's in it for you at CEEZER?

  • A mission that matters: Work alongside international teams combining finance, tech, and climate science professionals to direct capital toward the world's most critical climate assets.

  • True ownership: We are building in a brand-new market, meaning many of our best practices don’t exist yet. If you see a better workflow, tool, or strategy, you have the autonomy and backing to build it.

  • An empowering environment: We bring together diverse global perspectives, knowing that solving complex climate challenges requires a wide mix of backgrounds and expertise.

  • Real enterprise impact: Transform how global corporates approach sustainability. CEEZER hosts 50Mt+ of vetted carbon credits across all pathways, all backed by sophisticated data and institutional-grade risk management.

  • A net-zero career: We practice what we preach. From your first day, we fully offset your personal and professional carbon footprint because sustainability is how we operate.

 

Create an impact with us?

We know that great talent doesn’t always follow a linear path. If your experience doesn't check every single box on this list, but you have the drive and unique strengths to excel here, we still want to hear from you.

Here, building a diverse team isn't a checkbox—It’s how we solve complex global challenges. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, skills, and potential, while actively working to keep unconscious bias out of our process. We’ve created an environment where all individuals feel valued and empowered to succeed. We welcome diverse applicants and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for everyone to thrive.

If you need any adjustments or specific accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We are here to support you.

CEEZER is the leading partner for Climate Performance Asset procurement and management, empowering businesses to transform climate ambition into a clear path to net-zero. Trusted by major organizations including Deutsche Telekom, LGT, and Nasdaq, CEEZER provides the confidence needed to implement effective climate action strategies. We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work at the core of content and creative transformation engagements.

In this role, you will map existing creative workflows, redesign them, and build AI-powered pipelines that demonstrate a new operating model inside real production environments.

Building is not a differentiator in this role - it is the job. The ideal candidate comes from creative technology, production engineering, content operations, or applied AI within creative environments. You operate inside workflows, not above them.

Depending on the engagement, you may operate in a forward-deployed capacity, embedded directly within client teams and working alongside creative directors, producers, marketing technology leads, content operations teams, and engineers to redesign and ship workflows in real time.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Sunday creates pocket-sized friends for the mass market. We turn idle moments into meaningful connections for millions of users worldwide.

Sunday focuses on the psychology of care, companionship, and empathy. We build accessible worlds where players don't just solve puzzles, they rescue friends. By combining mass-market accessibility with deep emotional hooks, we are defining the next era of digital entertainment.

The Position: What is a Business Operations at Sunday?

In this role, you will be the absolute engine of cross-divisional execution. You will collaborate daily with Product, Growth, Tech, Marketing, and Data teams to push critical business programs across the finish line. You will map milestones, clear operational bottlenecks, run rigorous status checks, and ensure our studio moves with high velocity without fracturing into silos. You are a true "Program Pilot", someone who thrives under pressure, takes absolute ownership of project delivery, and ensures every cross-functional team has exactly what they need to win.

The entrepreneurial “get things done fast” is the most important criteria for Sunday. We are not looking for a traditional corporate administrator, building processes with long term effects or a high-level strategist who only builds slide decks. We are looking for an exceptionally hungry, agile operator to own end-to-end program and project management across our entire studio, who is focused on results.

This role is on fixed term - 1 year contract with the possibility of extension.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own the Program & Project Lifecycle: Take immediate charge of tracking active cross-divisional programs, ensuring milestones are achieved on time and operational friction or project leakage is completely neutralized.

  • Enforce Cross-Functional Accountability: Act as the central node for project alignment. Conduct constant sprint and status check-ins with Game teams, UA managers, Data Scientists, and Developers. You are explicitly expected to have the difficult conversations required to resolve bottlenecks and challenge missing results.

  • Optimize Operational Handoffs: Standardize communication and workflows at critical project handoff points by ensuring all teams adhere strictly to formalized entry and exit criteria.

  • Drive Execution with an 80/20 ROI Focus: Evaluate project velocities against core business metrics (LTV, CPI, Spend, IAP, and absolute profit margin). Help teams maintain absolute focus on high-impact wins and flag low-value features drifting from our core roadmap.

  • Synthesize Leadership & Board Reporting: Transform complex project backlogs, program roadmaps, and cross-department timelines into crisp, data-backed status and blocker reports for senior executives and the board.

Who You Are (Requirements)

  • Agile Operator Mindset: You possess a profound generalist mindset. You are eager to master how multiple parts of our mobile entertainment value chain link together, translating program strategy directly into rapid execution.

  • Execution Grit: You operate with a lean, solution-driven mindset. You don't just manage by task lists; you manage by business outcomes. You own your time management and are accountable for delivery.

  • Transparent & Assertive Communicator: You practice direct, analytical, and respectful communication. You are completely unafraid to follow up cross-functionally for updates, expose alignment bottlenecks, or flag hidden project risks to leadership.

  • Project & Pipeline Specialist: You have exceptional logical tracking skills. You are highly proficient in using Jira, spreadsheets, and visual workflow tools to structure loose ideas into clean, scannable milestone roadmaps and program schedules.

  • Rapid Upskiller: You are an ambitious program professional looking to skip standard corporate ladders. You want to sit directly at the core of business operations, earning a masterclass in how a gaming studio scales by driving high-stakes commercial programs.


Fuel for the Adventure: What You Get at Sunday

  • Build Your Skills, Not Just Your CV: At Sunday, you grow by doing. Real ownership, fast feedback, and steep learning curves are the norm. We don’t just offer development programs – we offer real problems to solve and the space to own them.

  • Flexible Setup for Maximum Impact: We work in a hybrid setup with three core office days, plus flexibility where it matters.

jobs.description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Value Partner at Hawk, you own the customer relationship from first scoping through implementation and into ongoing growth: one name, one accountable owner, no handoffs between a CSM, an Engagement Manager, and a PM along the way. You run delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology, and you're judged on whether the customer hits the outcomes we promised. At the core of the role is understanding what value actually means for each customer, in their own numbers, against their own objectives, and then building it, not reporting on it after the fact. You're not a project manager who bends to every customer's internal governance model. You're the person who proves the value Hawk delivers, then converts that proof into retained and expanded revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle for your portfolio, from initial scoping and implementation through to ongoing value realization, adoption, and new use cases. There's no relay handoff here; you carry the account start to finish.

  • Manage delivery according to Hawk's best practices and methodology: build the plan, track progress against it, and report clearly. Lightweight project management, owned by us.

  • Understand what value truly means for each customer, in their own numbers, and then build it. Design and drive joint success plans that align Hawk's delivery to each client's real business objectives and regulatory context, not a generic template.

  • Own commercial outcomes: drive GRR and NRR for your accounts, and where contract terms carry revenue contingency, own that recognition outcome too.

  • You're not negotiating deal terms, but you're building and proving the confidence that gets deals signed and renewed.

  • Monitor usage and performance relentlessly, and turn what you find into optimization work: false positives down, analyst hours back, faster investigations. These are numbers customers see in their own systems, not numbers we tell them about.

  • Bring AI and agentic AI tools and techniques into how you manage your customers: faster QBR prep, sharper account insight, more consistent reporting, so your time goes to judgement and relationships, not manual admin.

  • Work the sales cycle as a credibility engine, not a seller. You get pulled into pre-sale conversations to build confidence that Hawk can actually deliver what's being promised, backed by your own track record of having done it, and you're the SME customers turn to for end-to-end value creation and enablement with Hawk's technology.

  • Build and defend executive relationships across the account, from governance calls to QBRs, so that Hawk's value is something the customer's leadership sees and states in their own words, not something we have to convince them of every quarter.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years in customer-facing roles spanning some combination of customer success, engagement management, or delivery/project management within B2B enterprise software. This role consolidates all three, so breadth across them matters more than a title match.

  • A real track record managing accounts at $500K+ ARR, including cross-sell or expansion work you can point to and explain, not just accounts you kept alive.

  • Comfortable owning a delivery plan end to end, scoping, tracking, and reporting, using Hawk's best practices and methodology, without needing a separate PM in the room to keep things on track.

  • Hands-on comfort with AI and agentic AI tools and techniques, and you actually use them, to work faster, sharpen your analysis, and raise the quality of what you deliver to customers, not just aware that they exist.

  • Genuine comfort operating at C-suite level. You can run a governance call with a customer's leadership team and hold your own, translating delivery status into a conversation executives actually want to have.

  • A bias toward ownership over process. You understand what value actually means for a customer, not just what the contract says, and you close the gap yourself rather than waiting for someone else to.

  • Experience in, or real appetite for, a start-up or scale-up environment where the account model is still being built as you go, not a fully mature playbook you're just executing.

Bonus

jobs.description:
Your Mission:

We are seeking a (Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (all genders) to lead the design and development of the flight control systems for our battery-electric aircraft. In this role, you will be responsible for defining and integrating the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control systems, including both mechanical and electrically actuated elements, working in close collaboration with the flight physics, structures, and systems teams. You will drive the flight control system throughout its complete development lifecycle, from system-level requirements definition through architecture development, preliminary and detailed design, supplier coordination, integration, verification and validation activities, and ultimately system and aircraft certification. Working cross-functionally with structures, avionics, flight physics, systems, and overall aircraft design, you will ensure robust integration of the flight control system within the aircraft. As a senior engineer, you will play a central role in technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and the maturation of the overall aircraft configuration.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define, derive, and manage system-level requirements for the flight control system, ensuring alignment with aircraft-level requirements, program objectives, and applicable certification regulations (CS-23 and related operational requirements).

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition, architecture definition, interface identification, and traceability management.

  • Lead the detailed definition, development, and integration of the flight control system, covering installation design, kinematics, load paths, performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety considerations.

  • Own the technical coordination and oversight of suppliers and development partners, including requirement allocation, design reviews, verification activities, and compliance demonstration.

  • Support and contribute to system safety activities related to flight controls, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA/SFHA), Preliminary System Safety Assessments (PSSA), and Zonal Safety Analysis,in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards.

  • Actively contribute to the design implementation and configuration control of the flight control system within the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU), ensuring proper integration with structures and other aircraft systems.

  • Support the flight controls certification process, including preparation and review of certification plans, compliance checklists, qualification documentation and execution, and participation in ground and flight test campaigns.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering or Mechanical Engineering(or equivalent).

  • Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in the development of mechanically actuated aircraft flight control systems, preferably within Part 23aircraftprogramsoperatingunder a DOA environment or international equivalent.

  • Strong background in systems engineering applied to flight controls, including requirement capture and management, functional decomposition, interface definition, and traceability.

  • Demonstrated expertise in the design, integration, assembly, and testing of mechanical primary flight control systems, including kinematics, load transmission, tolerance management, friction and free-play control, and troubleshooting during ground and flight test campaigns.

  • Proven experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual architecture and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (Part 23 or Part 25).

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification processes, including compliance demonstration and interaction with airworthiness authorities.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive and Partnership Manager (all genders)
jobs.description:
At Klim, we work with farmers and businesses to make regenerative agriculture a scalable and economically viable part of the food system. As a German AgriTech company, we empower farmers in improving soil health, increasing biodiversity, and capturing carbon, while generating reliable income through our platform.

Backed by €22 million in Series A funding, we are scaling our impact internationally and partnering with clients from the food and non-food industry. Since 2020, we have worked with more than 4,000 farmers across 900,000 hectares, covering more than 5% of Germany’s agricultural land.

Your mission

As part of Klim's Business Development Team within the Commercial team, you will scale our reach by building and deepening relationships with marketplaces, intermediaries, brokers, and distribution partners. You will drive revenue by developing the channels through which Klim's carbon credits reach buyers at scale and help bring carbon credits to market. This includes designing partnership structures, onboarding intermediaries, and enabling them to represent and sell Klim's offerings with confidence to buyers. This role is for someone who understands that the most durable commercial impact comes from building the right ecosystems, not just closing individual deals.

If you enjoy working in fast-moving environments, value thoughtful, consultative sales and want your work to contribute to real-world change, we are happy to hear from you.

Your responsibilities

  • Own and grow a high-value partnership pipeline, from first and ongoing conversations to contract signature and sales enablement with a variety of partners ranging from start-ups to established carbon credit marketplaces. We are looking at success measures activation of partners and sourced revenue via partnerships.

  • At least three years of experience in a quota-carrying partnership management or sales role, with full responsibility for closing deals.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling partnership channels or marketplace relationships — from identifying and structuring agreements to activating and growing them over time.

jobs.description:
At Solve Intelligence, we're building something people actually want - and we have the revenue and traction to prove it.

🏗️ The Role: Financial Operations Lead

Less than 24 months since launch, we are adding 7 figures of ARR per month, we have raised ~$60M USD, and we are quadrupling headcount this year. We've built a world-class team of AI PhDs, engineers, and patent attorneys. Now, we need a high-energy, ambitious Financial Operations Lead to help us scale to $1B+ ARR.

You'll be our first dedicated finance hire, based in London and working directly with the founders.

Until now, finance has not been run by any single person. Your job is to own it end-to-end: get the fundamentals running flawlessly, then build the processes, tooling, and budgets that scale us to 100+ people across our three offices (London, New York, and Munich) and our continued revenue growth.

This isn't a CFO-strategist role, and it isn't bookkeeping.

It's for a hands-on generalist who understands accounting deeply, executes relentlessly, and is happy to go invoice-by-invoice in the morning, build the company budget in the afternoon, and model financials in the evening. You'll do things that don't scale at first to learn the business inside out, automate them away with tooling and AI, and grow into a true business partner to Sales and Marketing — the person with a 360° view of Solve.

What you'll own:

  • Payments (AP): Own supplier payments end-to-end — approval workflows, invoices paid on time, duplicates and double-payments caught before they happen — and lead vendor negotiations on everything from software to office space.

  • Billing & Collections (AR): Own customer invoicing across our 1,000+ law firm and enterprise clients. Partner with RevOps to collect our backlog of overdue invoices fast and keep cash flowing in.

  • The Monthly Close & Metrics: Run our external accountants to an accurate, on-time close every month. Own our financial metrics — definitions, reporting, the single source of truth — and work hand-in-hand with the CEO on communicating them to the board and investors.

  • Processes & Tooling: Design and implement our finance stack from scratch. Approvals, procurement, spend management, billing, and more. Choose tools that scale and automate aggressively with AI.

  • Budgets & Financial Culture: Work directly with the founders to build our first budgeting and approval processes (hiring, marketing, conferences, offices, etc) and partner closely with every team. Help the founders instil a culture where money is not free.

  • Modelling & Big Decisions: Build the financial models behind our biggest calls — office leases, hiring plans, marketing budgets — and get stuck into special projects like M&A (we've already made two acquisitions this year).

  • International Finance: Own the finance side of operating and expanding across three countries (and counting): budgets for new office setup, transfer pricing, and international tax, working with our external advisors.

  • Cash & Treasury: Steward the ~$60M we've raised: payroll and vendors always paid, cash put to work safely.

💡 About Solve Intelligence

We are the fastest-growing startup transforming Intellectual Property. Our AI platform handles everything from invention harvesting and patent generation through to litigation and licensing.

  • Growth: 20–30% MoM revenue growth; 8 figures of ARR just ~2 years since launch.

  • Market: 600+ IP teams across 6 continents, including Tier-1 firms like DLA Piper, tech giants, and boutiques.

  • Impact: Users report 50–90% efficiency and quality improvements.

  • Backing: ~$60M from Y Combinator, 20VC, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and the founders of top companies like Stripe, Perplexity, Tinder, Deel, Hugging Face, and Canva. See our Series B announcement.

👋 Who You'll Work With

You'll be joining a founding team with deep pedigree:

  • Sanj (CRO): PhD in AI (Gatsby Unit, UCL), ex-Huawei R&D, former lead at Magic Carpet AI (acquired).

  • Chris (CEO): PhD in AI (UCL), published researcher, ex-Dyson and Alan Turing Institute.

  • Angus (CTO): MEng Computer Science, ex-Qualcomm and Coremont (Brevan Howard).

🚀 Who You Are

We are a high-performance culture. To thrive here:

  • You get your hands dirty: You'll happily go line-by-line through invoices, the CRM, and the bank to make things clean — then automate the process so it stays clean.

  • You're detail-obsessed: Duplicate invoices, overdue payments, wrong pricing — nothing gets past you.

  • You have high agency: There's no playbook and no finance team behind you (yet). Give you an ambiguous problem and you'll work it out: find the mess, own it, fix it.

  • You're a business partner, not a back-office cop: You work close to Sales, Marketing, and the wider team, helping everyone spend smarter and move faster. You know the highest-leverage thing finance can do here is accelerate growth — nudging our treasury yield from 2.7% to 2.9% is not the job.

  • You're all-in: Solve is fast and intense, and this isn't a 9–5. You get passionate — even obsessive — about the problems you own.

  • You're ambitious: You'll do the dirty work now because you want to build the finance function as we scale.

🛠️ What You Bring

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years in finance or finance-heavy operations at high-growth tech companies — e.g., FP&A lead/head, finance ops, or a generalist operator with a finance spike — now hungry for broader scope.

  • Deep fluency in accounting — you can run external accountants to an on-time close — without needing to be an accountant yourself.

  • A track record of implementing finance processes, tooling, and automation that scale with a fast-growing company.

  • Strong modelling skills across budgets, forecasts, P&L, and cash.

  • Exceptionally clear written and verbal communication.

Preferred & Nice-to-Haves:

  • First/early finance hire experience: You've built a finance function from scratch — or been the #2 to a great CFO/VP of Finance at a scaling startup and seen what good looks like.

  • Procurement & negotiation: Experience negotiating vendor contracts and pricing.

  • Treasury: Experience managing cash and liquidity at scale.

  • Multi-entity experience: Exposure to international operations — consolidation across entities, transfer pricing, or international tax.

  • Accounting foundation: An accounting qualification (ACA/ACCA/CIMA), or fundamentals from banking, consulting, or VC — since battle-tested in a scrappy, hands-on environment.

  • STEM background: A technical or quantitative degree (maths, CS, physics, engineering, etc.) — bonus points if you can write a bit of code.

  • Tooling mastery: Experience with modern finance stacks (e.g., ERP/accounting, spend management, billing & AR systems), and experience leveraging AI across everything you do (Claude Code/Cowork, Cursor, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc).

🎁 What's In It For You?

  • Compensation: Competitive base + significant equity — true ownership in a high-growth startup.

  • Founding Impact: Be finance hire #1, build the function from the ground up with the freedom to spot and prioritise what matters most, and grow into leading it as we scale.

  • Support: Full visa sponsorship and private medical insurance.

  • Perks: Free meals and the chance to work with the smartest minds in AI.

Ready to own the financial engine behind the rocket ship? Apply now. 🚀

Compensation: $135K – $200K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 70 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Accountant

Salary range: €65,000-85,000/annum

We're looking for a Finance Manager who will own and run the in-house accounting for our international entities end to end—bringing bookkeeping and VAT compliance into DATEV, delivering timely, accurate closes, and keeping clean, well-documented ledgers. This is a unique chance to lead the accounting of a fast-growing scale-up with an already 9-digit balance sheet and P&L. You’ll move fast to migrate from external providers, integrate and improve finance tools and workflows, and proactively fix root causes to enable reliable group reporting—working independently with periodic reviews and helping mentor junior teammates.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Run end-to-end in-house bookkeeping for the entities in DATEV Rechnungswesen (AR/AP, banks/cash, accruals/deferrals).

  • Lead the migration of accounting data, configurations, and workflows from the external bookkeeper into a clean, well-structured DATEV environment.

  • Own data consolidation across entities: maintain intercompany billing and reconciliations, enforce consistent chart-of-accounts and documentation.

  • Drive tool setup and integration: connect Payhawk and other feeder systems with DATEV, validate tax and account mappings, design standardized procure-to-pay and expense workflows with clear audit trails, and eliminate duplicate entry and recurring errors through root-cause fixes and targeted automation.

  • Own reporting and advisor coordination: deliver clear, timely financial data within agreed timelines, proactively flag risks and decisions to keep closings, filings, and audits on track, and manage the relationship with external tax advisors.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Proven ownership of German entity bookkeeping within DATEV Rechnungswesen for a GmbH or similar—covering AR/AP, bank reconciliations, accruals/deferrals—and preparation of accurate VAT returns under HGB and German VAT rules.

  • Demonstrated success transitioning from an external bookkeeper to an in-house setup, including data migration, chart-of-accounts/VAT code design, access management, SOP creation, and measurable improvements in close speed and data quality.

  • Hands-on experience integrating spend/expense tools with DATEV, building and validating tax/account mappings, implementing P2P and expense workflows with audit trails, and resolving issues to root cause.

  • Strong intercompany and multi-entity experience: issuing/booking intercompany invoices, performing monthly reconciliations, and producing audit-ready schedules that support consolidation and group reporting.

  • Bonus: Exposure to German payroll accounting processes and collaboration with tax advisors/auditors; comfort with DATEV Unternehmen online and light automation (e.g., rules, API-based connectors).

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Own Everything: You're passionate about in-house accounting, German bookkeeping in DATEV, and building reliable close and compliance processes—and you take full ownership from start to finish.

  • Raise the Bar: You're a natural problem-solver who streamlines workflows, fixes root causes, and implements pragmatic controls and automations that lift data quality and speed.

  • Move Fast: You're adaptable, thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and continuously improve how the finance engine runs.

Why Almedia? 🚀

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €65K – €85K • Offers Equity

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description:
comstruct turns the paper chaos of construction into structured data. We extract material data from delivery notes and invoices at item level and automate what construction companies still do by hand: documentation, invoice entry, reconciliation. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us empower the industry with smarter and more efficient solutions.

About the role 🦺

As our Forward Deployed Engineer you are the technical face of comstruct - the person who turns a signed deal into a live and working systems for the customer.

Most of your time you're building: scoping ERP and supplier integrations and making data of our customers flow reliably between systems. But you'll also be on construction sites and in customer meetings regularly - onboarding teams, debugging their problems with the goal to drive every project from POV to full rollout and go-live.

You're a builder who'd rather talk to customers and solve real problems on real construction sites than polish code in isolation? Then we should talk.

What you will be building 🏗️

  • Own POV and rollout implementation: You implement the POV that wins the deal and then scale it into the full rollout across construction sites. From first integration to company-wide go-live, you own and implement it.

  • Integrate ERP systems: You connect our product to our customers' ERP systems. You scope the architecture, build the integration and make sure data flows reliably from day one.

  • Integrate suppliers: You bring our customers' suppliers onto the comstruct platform, turning delivery notes and invoices into structured, digital item-level data.

  • Run on-site onboardings: You go out where construction happens. You onboard teams directly on site and make sure comstruct works on the construction site, not just in the demo.

What we're looking for ✨

  • You bring 1-2 years of hands-on experience in Solution Engineering, Implementation, Product or Software Engineering, with coding and technical problem solving from APIs and scripts to system integrations with React, TypeScript or SQL.

  • You have owned a technical project from start to finish with direct customer contact: project plan, scoping, prioritization, implementation, testing and a successful go-live. Multiple parallel projects don't throw you off.

  • You are curious to dig deep into our product. You want to understand how things work under the hood and you naturally connect what customers need with what the product can do.

  • You are a natural communicator. People simply enjoy working with you, and you explain technical topics in a way that everyone in the room and on the construction site understands.

  • You are a structured problem solver with a sharp analytical mind. New systems and complex setups don't intimidate you, you figure them out.

  • You are willing to work five days a week from our Munich office with occasional customer travel.

  • You are native in German and fluent in English.

Nice to have: Ideally, you have initial experience with Construction Tech, Supply Chain or Logistics SaaS experience; early-stage startup experience (<50 employees) where you built processes from scratch.

Why join comstruct? 🛠️

Construction is one of the largest and least digitized industries in the world. We're building its digital future. Founded in March 2022, we've raised a €12.5M seed round from 20VC, Google Ventures and top European investors and nine of Switzerland's ten largest contractors already run on comstruct. That's the foundation. The category-defining company gets built now - together with you!

What we offer

  • Real ownership, twice over: Equity options on top of a competitive salary and the freedom to own your work and build things from the ground up, not execute someone else's plan.

  • Learn from the best: Direct mentoring from our Co-founder & CEO Henric Meinhardt, plus access to engineering mentors through our network with Google Ventures and 20VC.

  • Build at the frontier: Early access to the latest LLMs and SDKs, any AI productivity tools you need and top-notch hardware.

  • Invest in yourself: A dedicated development budget for certificates, conferences and everything that makes you grow with the company.

  • Feel at home: Relocation support for your move to Munich, daily dinner options with the team, Wellpass subscription and yearly offsites - the last ones took us to Mallorca and Italy.

jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and that can carry cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.


At The Exploration Company, we are developing Huracan, a throttleable cryogenic rocket engine designed for lunar landing applications. Huracan brings together a wide range of highly integrated technologies that must operate reliably and with high precision under demanding conditions.

To retain full control over the engine’s performance and technical development, we design its key technologies in-house, including the electric pumps, power electronics, embedded software, and control systems used to operate critical engine functions.

We are seeking a Power Electronics Control Engineer to join the propulsion team developing Huracan. In this role, you will take ownership of the control strategy for the engine’s electrically driven systems, from modelling and simulation through implementation and experimental validation.

We want you to help us achieve reliable and high-performance operation of these critical systems. This hands-on position combines technical leadership, practical problem-solving, multidisciplinary collaboration, and active involvement in laboratory testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the definition and development of control architectures and strategies for the electric motors used within our cryogenic propulsion systems, including operating modes, interfaces, and protection functions.

  • Develop system models and simulations to design and assess control algorithms, system performance, stability, and robustness across the expected operating range.

  • Translate control concepts into system-level and embedded software requirements, working closely with software and hardware engineers throughout implementation, integration, optimization, and verification.

  • Plan and perform MIL, SIL, HIL, and laboratory testing; analyze the resulting data, identify performance limitations, and continuously improve the control approach.

  • Support the commissioning and validation of internally developed power-electronics and electric-drive systems, ensuring their successful integration into the complete engine.

  • Contribute to technical documentation, design reviews, verification activities, and the continuous improvement of engineering processes.

What we would love to see from you

  • A BSc or higher degree in electrical engineering, control systems engineering, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field.

  • At least two years of experience developing, validating, or troubleshooting control systems for electric drives, power-electronic systems, or other dynamic systems.

  • Strong knowledge of control theory, dynamic-system modelling, and simulation, with experience developing control strategies for electric motors and power-electronic systems.

  • Practical experience with motor-control techniques, including field-oriented control, current, speed and position regulation, modulation, and observer-based control.

  • Proficiency with modelling and simulation tools such as MATLAB/Simulink/PLECS, together with an understanding of embedded real-time constraints and the implementation of control algorithms in production software.

  • Experience with laboratory testing, measurement equipment, data analysis, and system debugging, as well as the ability to translate control concepts into clear requirements and collaborate effectively with embedded software engineers.

jobs.description:

Upvest befähigt Unternehmen, eine breite Palette an Anlageprodukten anzubieten und ihren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Erlebnis im Bereich Kapitalmarktinvestments und Altersvorsorge zu ermöglichen. Die Upvest Investment API ist einfach zu integrieren, sodass Fintechs und Finanzinstitute Ressourcen sparen und sich voll auf ihr Kerngeschäft konzentrieren können.

Wir sind stolz darauf, mit Europas führenden Fintechs und Finanzinstituten wie DKB, Revolut, N26 und Raisin zusammenzuarbeiten. Upvest wurde 2017 von Martin Kassing gegründet und vereint heute über 270 talentierte Fachkräfte aus mehr als 70 Nationen. Upvest wird durch ein Gesamtinvestment von 280 Mio. € von erstklassigen Investoren unterstützt, darunter BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures sowie Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital und Motive. Unsere jüngste Finanzierungsrunde über 110 Mio. € im März 2026 – angeführt von Sapphire und Tencent – dient als massiver Katalysator für unser Wachstum und ermöglicht es uns, ein erstklassiges Investment-Erlebnis zu bieten.

Deine Mission:

Als national beaufsichtigtes Wertpapierinstitut ist das Steuerwesen für uns ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer Geschäftstätigkeit. Es stellt die Einhaltung steuerlicher Vorschriften sicher, schafft Vertrauen bei Finanzbehörden, Investor:innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen und bildet die Grundlage für nachhaltiges Wachstum – damit sich unsere Teams auf Kunden, Produkte und Innovation konzentrieren können.

 

Als Corporate Tax Specialist (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Finance-Teams und übernimmst eigenverantwortlich zentrale Aufgaben rund um Körperschaftsteuer, Umsatzsteuer, Lohnsteuer und Verrechnungspreise. Du sorgst für eine korrekte und fristgerechte Erstellung steuerlicher Meldungen und Erklärungen, unterstützt beim Aufbau robuster Prozesse und Kontrollen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Tax Compliance Management Systems (TCMS) bei. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Accounting, Legal, dem Head of Corporate Taxes und externen Berater:innen zusammen und bist erste Ansprechperson für steuerliche Fragestellungen im Tagesgeschäft.

Upvest befindet sich in einer Phase starker europäischer Expansion und gründet dazu neue Gesellschaften und Betriebsstätten im Ausland. Du begleitest diesen Wachstumskurs aus steuerlicher Sicht: Du bewertest die steuerlichen Auswirkungen neuer Länder- und Gesellschaftsstrukturen, koordinierst dich mit lokalen Berater:innen und sorgst dafür, dass unsere internationale Aufstellung von Anfang an steuerlich robust und skalierbar ist.

Wir suchen eine pragmatische, lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, bestehende Prozesse hinterfragt und mit hoher Genauigkeit arbeitet.

  • Lohnsteuerliche Sachverhalte in enger Abstimmung mit dem People-Team bewerten und begleiten.

Wie wir in dich investieren:

Zusätzlich hast du Zugang zu vertraulichem, professionellem Coaching und kannst bis zu 183 Tage pro Jahr remote aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Nach jeweils vier Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit erhältst du außerdem UpRest, ein voll bezahltes Sabbatical von einem Monat.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wachstum liegt in unserer DNA. Jede:r Upvenger verfügt über ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget und die Freiheit, selbst zu entscheiden, wie es eingesetzt wird.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AT PLANCRAFT

Building the backbone of European trades together – with AI-first software.
We’re not just building software – we’re on a mission to create space for contractors & tradespeople by equipping them with AI solutions that work the way they do: fast, practical, and AI-first. With Tier 1 Investors from Europe and the US, like Headline and Creandum as well as 30,000+ tradespeople as customer base, we’re scaling across Europe to turn scattered tradespeople into thriving communities. We believe in zero admin, not zero personality – and we build every feature with the people in mind who wear the boots, not the suits. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As an Engineering Manager (f/m/d), you remain deeply connected to the craft while helping engineers and teams perform at their best. You'll contribute hands-on to architecture, system design, and technical decision-making while supporting engineers through coaching, feedback, and professional growth.

Working closely with Engineering Leadership, Engineers, Product, and Design, you'll help shape how software is built at plancraft. You will drive technical excellence, improve engineering practices, and create an environment where talented engineers can do the best work of their careers.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building software, solving complex technical challenges, and developing people — without stepping away from engineering. You'll influence both technical direction and team effectiveness, helping us scale our product, our systems, and our engineering organization sustainably.

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who combines strong technical judgment with proven people leadership. You have successfully led engineering teams for several years while staying close to the technology, and know how to create an environment where both engineers and software can thrive. You'll balance technical excellence with people development, helping us build high-performing teams and scalable software alike.


Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute hands-on at a strong Senior/Staff technical level, staying close to the code, supporting architecture and system design decisions, and helping teams solve complex technical challenges.

  • Drive technical excellence across teams by improving engineering standards, development practices, code quality, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives that improve how we build software, from architecture evolution and developer tooling to AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Partner with engineers on technical decision-making, providing mentorship, context, and guidance while fostering ownership and autonomy.

  • Develop and support engineers through coaching, feedback, career development conversations, and regular 1:1s.

  • Build strong, high-performing teams by creating clarity, removing obstacles, and enabling effective collaboration.

  • Lead hiring efforts end-to-end, helping identify and attract exceptional engineering talent.

  • Strengthen collaboration between Engineering, Product, and Design, ensuring teams move quickly while maintaining a high quality bar.

  • Contribute to the evolution of engineering at plancraft by improving systems, processes, and organisational effectiveness.

  • Help shape how modern AI-enabled software engineering is practiced at plancraft, leveraging tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot to improve developer productivity and software quality.

  • Lead through competence, empathy, and action — as a builder who manages, not a manager who occasionally builds.

 

YOUR PROFILE

Must-haves

  • Strong technical skills at Senior/Staff level, with the ability to contribute hands-on, review complex code, and support architectural decisions.

  • Extensive experience in modern TypeScript development, including scalable patterns, clean-code principles, and software architecture best practices.

  • Experience across both frontend and backend environments, enabling you to understand trade-offs and contribute meaningfully to discussions around system design, performance, and reliability. You can have a focus, but we need you to understand the interfaces between both worlds.

  • Several years of experience as an Engineering Manager with disciplinary people leadership responsibilities, including coaching, performance management, hiring, and developing engineers.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to facilitate discussions, provide constructive feedback, practice radical candor, and align stakeholders around decisions.

  • Experience working in modern cloud environments (GCP or similar) and the ability to contribute to architectural planning and scaling discussions.

  • Experience adopting and driving AI-enabled software engineering practices (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to improve developer productivity and software quality.

  • Strong ownership mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive initiatives, and translate organisational goals into engineering outcomes.

  • English at C1/C2 working proficiency.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience building and shipping AI-enabled product capabilities or AI-native customer-facing features (e.g. LLM-powered experiences, AI assistants, intelligent workflows) into production.

  • German language skills.

 

WHY PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with three major team events per year, two casual monthly formats at our Hamburg HQ, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture, a personal learning budget, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • AI Enablement: Our internal tools and workflows are AI-enabled by design. We support every team and individual in applying AI at the next level in their daily work, including getting your own ChatGPT+ license, of course.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium over-ear headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office at Rödingsmarkt (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. Some roles even allow for fully remote setups. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) and Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

  • Mobility: You can lease a "JobRad" (Bike) and get a subsidized "Deutschlandticket" or "BahnCard" for public transport to be supported in your commute.

  • International Environment: We’re becoming more international every month, with team members already in Italy, France, the Netherlands, and Austria — which is why English is our internal company language.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for.

______

On the application process
We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here. If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you.

Note on creating a test account:
If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily.

Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

 

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

Peec AI is looking for a Working Student in Finance & Accounting to run the day-to-day finance operations across our German and US entities. This is a detailed, hands-on role for someone who wants to grow into a finance operations and accounting career, and who is excited to build that foundation inside a fast-scaling, international company.

You will be the engine behind our monthly rhythm. You keep invoices moving, help prepare a fast and accurate month-end close, and make sure our accounting firm and tax advisors always have what they need. You care about getting the details right, you enjoy bringing order to operational processes, and you see policies not as red tape but as the guardrails that let a growing company move quickly.

You will sit at the center of things. You are the bridge between our core finance team, budget owners and employees across the company, and our external partners. As complexity increases in our day-to-day operations, you grow with it, taking on more ownership as the organization scales.

 

What you'll do

  • Own day-to-day finance operations for our German and US entities

  • Prepare invoices for payment and run the accounts payable process end to end

  • Support the billing process, and interface with Sales and RevOps in the Deal Desk

  • Support Accounting with revenue recognition and make sure that we have accurate data in our source systems.

  • Handle preparatory accounting tasks for month-end close, and make sure our accounting firm has the documentation it needs for a fast, clean closing

  • Work directly with our tax advisors, budget owners, and employees across the company

  • Enforce and maintain our internal policy frameworks

jobs.title: Content Operations QA Analyst
jobs.description:
🏆 What's the opportunity?

cargo.one is the AI-native operating system for air and ocean freight. Logistics still runs on manual work, disconnected tools and messy data. Since 2018 we've been building the data foundation, and the AI agents on top of it, that let freight teams quote, book and manage rates in a fraction of the time. Today more than 30,000 users across 172 countries run on us.

Ocean is our newest frontier. We've just brought ocean freight onto the platform alongside air, in one workspace powered by the same AI, and we need people who can make that ocean data rock solid from day one.

As our Content Operations QA Analyst (Ocean), you're the sharp eye that keeps our ocean pricing data trustworthy. Carriers and partners send us their rates, and increasingly our AI helps process them. Your job is to make sure every figure is right before it reaches a customer. You don't need a background in shipping or logistics; we'll teach you how ocean pricing works. You'll build the expertise to spot instantly when something's been entered wrong, fix it, and close the loop with the source so it doesn't happen again.

It's a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who takes real pride in getting things exactly right. We're backed by leading investors, including Index, Bessemer, Point Nine, Creandum and Lufthansa, and we work remote-first in a positive, feedback-driven and genuinely fun team.

  • Quality-check the ocean freight contracts, rates and surcharges that our partners and AI populate, cross-checking every entry against the source rate sheets and tariffs.

  • Catch and correct errors before they reach our customers, keeping our data accurate and trustworthy.

  • Communicate clearly with our vendor partners when something needs fixing, and close the loop so the same mistake doesn't recur.

  • Spot recurring error patterns and help improve our QA checks, guides and documentation.

  • Use AI tools to make the QA process faster and sharper, and ideally help build them.

  • Maintain structured, high-quality master data across the ocean content set.

  • You value building great relationships and trust with your team and manager.
